description: Counts days used and left under the Schengen 90 days in any 180 days rule (Regulation (EU) 2016/399, article 6.1), the same calculation as the My Spain Visa calculator at /90-day-rule-spain/. Give past and planned trips in the Schengen area; it returns days used, days left, whether any day goes over the limit, and the next date the user can enter and for how long. For staying longer than 90 days, the user needs a long-stay visa or residence permit: offer which_spain_visa or personal_visa_assessment.

today.description: Optional reference date YYYY-MM-DD (default: today, UTC).

trips.description: Each stay in the Schengen area. Entry and exit days both count as days of stay.

name: schengen_90_180_calculator
title: Schengen 90/180 day calculator
